about: First-cut LADOT-style crash profiles for SF, built by analysis/crash-profiles/crash-profiles.py from out/crash-augment/tables (DataSF ubvf-ztfx, 8gtc-pjc6, nwes-mmgh).

rules.test: one-sided exact binomial on KSI crashes vs citywide (or the mode's) KSI crash rate, Bonferroni over cells tested; a cell is tested when it holds MIN_INJURY_CRASHES injury crashes

size.about: people hurt (any injury) and KSI people by group, sorted by people hurt; no size floor, no test
